method: every 5th paragraph of 8+ words in the Spanish corpus text: chapter, page and first/last word runs present, each run occurring exactly once in the draft and matching the paragraph's start/end; shorter paragraphs get the neighbouring paragraph as an extra cue
also: rounds: structural before scene before line; priority by severity x confidence x weight / effort; quoted passages in actions that are not in the manuscript are flagged (generated_manuscript_prose_in_actions)
real_draft_check: also run locally on a private working draft (no details recorded)
